topic: The MGC far-side-depletion BREAK gate
play: Do not build it. The interesting part is that it is backwards.

rationale: Buy the gold break when the order book ahead of it is empty.  ·  Proven wrong by: Named test: a 2,000-draw random-subset placebo on n=192.
